items.title: Notes on Qwen-Max-0428
items.summary: API DEMO DISCORD Previously, we opensourced a series of Qwen1.5 model ranging from 0.5 to 110 billion parameters. Now, we release a larger model, Qwen-Max-0428. Qwen-Max-0428 is an instruction-tuned model for chat service. Very recently, it is available via Chatbot Arena and it has now become the top-10 in the leaderboard. items.summaryZh: 通义千问团队发布了全新的指令微调大模型Qwen-Max-0428。该模型在Chatbot Arena竞技场中成功跻身前十名，并在MT-Bench多轮对话基准测试中表现出超越此前最大模型Qwen1.5-110B-Chat的性能，展现了其在复杂对话服务中的强大实力。
